winter.h1: Snowmobile Tours in Zakopane — Ride the Tatras with a Local Guide
winter.lead: A guided snowmobile trip in the mountains above Zakopane. Legal, verified routes, local instructors, and the view you came here for.

shoulder.h1: Buggy 4×4 & Quad Tours in Zakopane — No Snow Needed
shoulder.lead: Snowmobile season is over and the trails are open. 4×4 buggies and quads on scenic routes above Zakopane, with an instructor, no driving licence required.

summer.h1: Quad & Buggy Tours in Zakopane — No Licence Needed
summer.lead: One, two or three hours on scenic mountain trails above Zakopane. No driving licence required, always with a local instructor, always on legal routes.
